items.stem: The Indexing API returns success for a document upload. What does that prove?

options.text: The document is searchable for all permitted users
The request was accepted; the document is not yet searchable
Permissions for the document have been evaluated
The document has been added to the graph

items.stem: When do newly uploaded documents become available in search results?

options.text: When processingHistory is later than bulkUploadHistory
As soon as the last page of the upload is accepted
Exactly 15 minutes after the upload
After the next four-week native re-crawl

items.stem: A successful bulk upload includes 38,000 of the 38,400 pages previously indexed. What happens to the other 400?

options.text: They stay, because bulk uploads only add documents
They stay for 7 days and are then deleted
The upload is rejected until they are included
They are deleted asynchronously after the upload

items.stem: Which statement about the stale-deletion safeguard is accurate?

options.text: It verifies that each full crawl fetched the whole source
It prevents bulk uploads from deleting anything
Above 20% stale, deletion of those documents pauses for 7 days
It needs a support ticket to release paused deletions

items.stem: The previous bulk upload failed midway. What must the next bulk upload do?

options.text: Reuse the failed upload's uploadId to resume
Set forceRestartUpload, or the request fails
Run concurrently with a cleanup upload
Wait for the four-week re-crawl to clear it

items.stem: A burst of 50,000 group-membership changes arrives just before a set of document updates. Why might the documents appear late?

options.text: Permissions and documents share one backend queue
Documents always wait for the next full run
Membership changes lock the datasource for 24 hours
Glean processes memberships only at night

items.stem: A document has allowAnonymousAccess set to true. Who can see it in search?

options.text: Only users indexed for that datasource
Anyone on the public internet
No one until groups are assigned
Anyone who is signed into Glean

items.stem: You index a user for the datasource, but no document ACL names the user or any of the user's groups. What can the user now find?

options.text: Every document in the datasource
Documents shared with the user's source groups, automatically
Nothing new; indexing a user grants no document access
Documents from other datasources, newly unlocked

items.stem: A test datasource returns nothing for a user on its beta list. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: Test datasources never show documents
The user lacks permission on the documents themselves
Ranking signals are off, which hides results
The datasource needs activity data first

items.stem: A page appeared in search yesterday and disappeared after last night's full run. What do you check first?

options.text: Whether the full run fetched and uploaded that page
Whether the page's viewURL changed
Whether activity data stopped arriving
Whether the Client API token expired

items.stem: A scanned policy PDF is 91 MB. What can users do with it in Glean?

options.text: Search its full text, truncated at 16.875 MB
Nothing; files over 64 MB are rejected
Ask Assistant to summarize all of it
Find it by metadata; its content cannot ground an answer

items.stem: Before rolling a new connector out to Assistant, where should the admin validate coverage and permissions?

options.text: In the upload response logs
In Assistant's answers alone
In Search, as users with different permissions
In the count of indexed documents
